title: Bitcoin’s Odds Of Jumping North of $100K in 2026 Stand at 28%: Sept. 4, 2026
summary: Cryptocurrencies have been a driver of recent excitement on Wall Street as investors have taken a break from the artificial intelligence theme and have incrementally move into modern, decentralized financial instruments, generally speaking.
